name: Leaf-Shaped Self-Draining Soap Holder | Stylish Waterfall Design with Suction Base for Bathroom & Kitchen | Random Colors
description:
Upgrade your sink area with the Leaf-Shaped Self-Draining Soap Holder, designed to keep your soap dry, clean, and long-lasting. Its smart waterfall-style drainage prevents mushiness, reduces waste, and keeps your counter tidy. Equipped with a strong silicone suction cup, it installs easily — no drilling required — and sticks firmly to smooth surfaces. Made from durable BPA-free ABS and space aluminum, this lightweight yet stylish holder adds a fresh decorative touch to your bathroom or kitchen.Key Features:
 Leaf-shaped waterfall design for fast drainage
 Strong suction base for drill-free installation
 Prevents soap from softening and wasting Suitable for bathroom, kitchen, sink, or balcony
 Also ideal for sponges, scrubs, and brushesHow to Use:
1⃣ Clean and dry the surface.
2⃣ Press suction cup firmly to attach.
3⃣ Place soap on the inclined leaf tray.
4⃣ Rinse the holder occasionally to keep it clean.Safety Information:
 Install only on smooth, flat surfaces.
 Avoid overloading with heavy items.
 Keep away from direct heat sources.

Package Includes:
 1 × Leaf-Shaped Self-Draining Soap Holder
